title: Friendship City Condo Moving Guide: Bole Satellite Town Access
excerpt: Friendship City and Bole satellite-town moves: gate lists, freight lifts, Bole Road traffic, and how to book movers without end-of-month elevator fights.
content:
Friendship City logistics

Friendship City and similar Bole satellite compounds behave like small towns: visitor lists, move windows, and freight lifts are enforced strictly. Paperwork started late is the main reason trucks sit outside the gate on moving day—not distance from our Lemi Kura yard.

Before moving day

  • Submit truck plate, driver name, and crew IDs 48 hours ahead when management requires it.
  • Book freight or service lift slots in writing; photograph lift interior before and after.
  • Plan approach via Bole Road alternatives during rush—see Bole moving guide.
  • List disassembly needs (L-shaped sofas, imported kitchens, king beds) at survey.

Unit types and carry distance

Friendship City mixes mid-rise blocks and walk-up clusters. Ground-floor units may allow curb loading; upper floors depend on service lifts sized for mattresses and sofas—not just passenger elevators. Long internal loops from the gate to your block add trolley time; mention that distance when you request a quote so crew size matches reality.

Traffic and staging

Satellite-town gates may not allow long idling on internal loops. Crews sometimes stage on the boulevard and trolley through security—carry distance belongs in your quote. Align truck legal windows with freight timing.

End-of-month and neighbors

Friendship City towers queue at month-end—beat the rush or share one vendor day with a neighbor—group discounts.

Pricing

Studios through larger units start on 2026 cost guide and homepage pricing; stairs and long carries add at survey. Use written quotes only—avoid delala.

Compared with Ayat and Bole proper

Friendship City moves feel more like gated-town logistics than central Bole high-rises. If you are choosing between compounds, compare elevator rules with our Ayat guide and Bole overview before you sign a lease tied to a specific move window.
